statements.text: The Vigilance & Enforcement wing issued a report on suspected cartelisation in drain works contracts in three Urban Local Bodies, 2023–25.
statements.quote: Report of the Vigilance & Enforcement wing on suspected cartelisation in drain works contracts in three Urban Local Bodies, 2023–25.

statements.text: The Vigilance & Enforcement wing conducted a confidential analysis of 46 drain works contracts awarded during 2023–25 in three Urban Local Bodies.
statements.quote: The Vigilance & Enforcement wing undertook a confidential analysis of 46 drain works contracts awarded during 2023–25 in three Urban Local Bodies.

statements.text: The wing reported that in 31 of the 46 contracts, the same four bidders participated, and the lowest bid was within 0.5% of the estimate in 27 cases, indicating possible bid rotation.
statements.quote: In 31 of the 46 contracts, the same four bidders participated, and the lowest bid was within 0.5% of the estimate in 27 cases, indicating possible bid rotation.

statements.text: The wing recommended mandatory e-procurement analytics for works above Rs.25 lakhs and rotation of officers handling tender evaluation.
statements.quote: procurement analytics for works above Rs.25 lakhs, and (iii) rotation of officers handling tender evaluation.
